name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-content-calendar
title: React Content Calendar
shortDescription: Plan and track SharePoint Site Pages in month, week, and list views with publishing status, scheduled publication details, and local placeholders.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework web part built with React, Fluent UI 9, and PnPjs that gives content authors a central calendar for the current site's Site Pages library.
Review pages in month, week, or list views, filter by publishing status, and choose Site Page or a custom page content type from the property pane.

View scheduled or first-published date and time, author and editor details, and links to pages. Create draft Site Pages directly from the calendar or reserve dates with placeholders stored locally in the browser.
